tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Germanic hlud, 'fame', + wig, 'war' — 'famous warrior'. Its root is Germanic hlud + wig. Saint Louis IX, king of France. Louis is a Germanic name meaning “Famous warrior”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
